purpose: Trace each baseline test declaration to current source and scoped test results. Matching source does not prove that shared fixtures stayed the same.
method: Parse TypeScript test files under packages and protocol-test with Babel. Match string or template test titles, then compare callback syntax trees without source positions or comments.
Count direct assert and expect calls as syntax. Compare them as multisets, so one new assertion cannot satisfy two old occurrences.
Exclude fixture calls named test when their second argument is not a callback. Static declarations do not expand loops or parameterized cases; 566 declarations must not be called 581 run cases.
A retained callback or assertion can still run with a changed fixture or implementation. The final release must run all tests and review the changed fixtures.
Renamed and removed cases have manual replacement evidence or an explicit behavior-change note. Behavior changes follow the approved execution design.
Current source is the reviewed working-tree snapshot. Use file and title to locate a case after formatting. Recheck this trace after later edits.
New user-task tests with no baseline declaration appear under additionalCurrentChecks. Their assertions do not change the baseline declaration count.
Validation run IDs name separate local runs. Their scopes overlap; do not add their counts or describe them as one complete final E2E run. Release CI must check the exact release commit.

validationScope.result: Every mapped baseline case has passing local evidence. The two additional current checks also passed.
validationScope.limits: These are separate runs, not one complete final combined run. The optional live Cloudflare case is skipped. Build, image, Compose, and deployment results for a release must come from CI for its exact commit.
